name: create_order
description: Place an order and reserve stock for every line. Items are named by SKU rather than product_id, and payment_method_id must already be on the account. Orders are created pending.

items.description: Line items to order, each an object with a sku and an optional quantity that defaults to 1. At least one entry is required.

payment_method_id.description: A payment_method_id from the customer's account, e.g. PM001.

address_id.description: A saved address_id to ship to.

error_returns.when: The customer, or a SKU in items, does not exist.
items is empty, quantity is below 1, or the payment method is not on the account.
A SKU has fewer units available than requested.
